sourceChecks.claim: Puck pursuit, puck support and getting open, near- and far-support, creating and finding passing lanes, and acceptable on-ice conduct are the age-appropriate concepts for this band.
sourceChecks.scope: Fetched the PDF directly and read PDF pages 12-14, which carry the printed page numbers 6, 7 and 8, matching the section citation in every packet-07 scenario. PLAYER KNOWLEDGE lists puck pursuit and puck support ("Players should learn to make themselves available to receive a pass from a teammate. This is the beginning of the idea of getting open"); TEAM CONCEPTS adds "the beginning of near- and far-support concepts, as well as creating and finding passing lanes" and states that no time should be spent teaching team systems at this level. That supports the off-puck support and lane-finding teaching in these scenes and supports keeping them free of system prescriptions. It does not support any coordinate, any completed pass, any interception, or any Canadian playing rule. US age categories do not establish Canadian game rules.
